132.news_title: Lightgun Holster for your Arcade Cabinet
132.long_description: The Arcooda lightgun holsters have arrived into stock. Featuring steel construction with black powdercoated finish, they are suitable for older coin operated arcade machines, home made lightgun cabinets, and plug and play for current series Arcooda arcade machines. The Arcooda gun holster is manufactured by us for arcade operators. Key features include; - 1.5mm to 4.8mm thickness steel construction - black rough featured powdercoating used to hide heavy use/scratches in arcade environment - including soft internal cushioning for gun protection - suitable for left or right cabinet mounting - designed to be away from the shell of the cabinet to avoid cabinet damage - suitable for almost any arcade hand gun cabinet, replace rusted/broken holsters - suitable for almost all home lightgun products - plug and play into any late model Arcooda arcade machines including Xtreme 3.0, Tempest and Virtual Pinball machines The lightgun holster is available for purchase here.
